provenance.inputs: Frozen agent captures, independent annotation JSON, original source PDFs, and rendered evidence pages only.
provenance.author_overlap: This reviewer authored sac2018 annotations earlier. A is a disclosed self-review against a separately produced blind capture; B and C are cross-agent annotation reviews.
provenance.capture_independence: The parent reports creating and freezing captures from blind tasks and source PDFs before reading annotations. The comparison verified their bytes against the freeze commit; it cannot independently observe the parent's earlier mental state.
provenance.auxiliary_review: A source-only subagent checked Diffusion Policy evaluation aggregation and Sim-to-Real table uncertainty/trial conditions without reading capture JSON or application files.
provenance.human_review_required: All judgments remain agent judgments. No human approval or blinded human evaluation is claimed.

assessment_rules.statement_support: pass means expected statement details are covered and source-supported; partial means supported capture content omits an expected detail; fail means material contradiction or unsupported content. These are coverage judgments, not retrieval labels.
assessment_rules.numeric_mapping: Every mapping was selected by named quantity, unit, method/task/phase, and experimental condition. Only after semantic mapping may numerical equality be checked.
assessment_rules.numeric_denominator: Count annotation numeric_facts entries only. A detail stated elsewhere, or an extra capture number, does not enter this denominator. Repeated fact entries are not independent experiments.
assessment_rules.locator_match: The capture points to the same source passage/table as the annotation, including referenced captions or additional locators. A protocol paragraph may refer to a figure on another page.
